text: A T reads—timber is then introduced into each rhombed, with an inclination opposite to that of the diagonal timbers, thereby dividing it into two parts. The trust--pieces so in- tended into one rhombed, are to the diagonal frames where the key-stone is to the arch; for no weight or pressure on the fabric can alter its position in a longitudinal direction till compression takes place at the autumn, and extension of the various ties.
